verdict.rationale: Bruno supports team sharing of collections through Git: collections are plain-text files on disk, and a built-in Git UI handles init, diff, pull, commit and clone. Teams can share and update collections, but only through a Git repository they manage themselves. Bruno explicitly states it is offline-only with no cloud sync, ever, so there is no first-party synced shared workspace. Missing for 10: a native real-time or cloud-synced shared workspace, built-in team or workspace management without external Git hosting, and independent hands-on evidence of the team workflow.
